title: Hybrid load-curve synthesis and p95 regression detection suite
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Build a reproducible load synthesis and analysis suite that measures tokens/sec, p95 token latency, and regression signals for mixed workloads when continuous batching and request queueing interact. This ticket covers infrastructure changes to the harness, a new mixed-workload generator (hybrid sessions + background microbursts), extended instrumentation (per-token timelines, queue depth histograms), and statistical detection for regressions (baseline, alert rules).

Motivation: Existing probes focus on single-profile or stratified arrival shapes. Production shows interacting effects between continuous batching policies and multi-profile queueing that cause non-linear p95 amplification. We need a compact, automated suite that can surface those effects, quantify sensitivity to batch windows, and flag regressions early in CI and preprod runs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) New workload generator can emit at least three independent profiles concurrently (short chat-like, long-sampling, embedding) with configurable arrival distributions (poisson, bimodal, bursty).
2) Harness captures tokens/sec, per-request p50/p90/p95/p99, queue depth, batch sizes, KV cache hit/miss, and memory/GPU utilization at 1s granularity.
3) Automated regression detector that runs nightly against baseline and raises an alert if p95 increases by >15% with statistical significance (p<0.05) or if tokens/sec drops by >10% for the same cost profile.
4) Results are pushed to a Grafana dashboard and an S3 artifact bucket with JSON summaries and raw traces for failed runs.
5) Documentation and an example CI job in .github/workflows that gates merges to runtime-1.21 when configured.
instrumentation:
- Per-token timestamps and stage markers (queued, batched, dispatched, kernel-start, kernel-end, completed)
- Queue depth and batch size histograms (1s buckets)
- KV cache prefix hit logs (sampled at 1:100 for long traces)
- Export to Prometheus and push raw per-request traces to S3 (compressed ndjson)
- Add labels to metrics for model_variant, region, tenant_type (hosted/dedicated/private)
test_plan:
Phase A (local): implement generator that combines three profiles and validate shapes via synthetic verifier.
Phase B (preprod): run 24h sweep over batch_window_ms={8,16,24,32,64}, concurrency={16,64,256} and record surfaces (tokens/sec vs p95).
Phase C (nightly): establish 14-day baseline, run regression detector, and produce daily regression report.
Edge cases: run with simulated KV-cache warming/cold starts, and with intermittent GPU throttling to simulate noisy neighbors.
results_placeholder: Will populate with real run outputs. Expected output files: metrics_summary_<date>.json, raw_traces_<date>.ndjson.gz, dashboard_link. Initial synthetic runs targeted for 2025-02-25 will be attached here after completion.
